_comment: Pilot area: Old Town and New Town. PROPOSED in PLAN.md C14, awaiting owner confirmation. bbox_bng is [min_e, min_n, max_e, max_n] in EPSG:27700; bbox_wgs84 is [west, south, east, north] derived from it.

full.name: City of Edinburgh council area
full._comment: bbox_bng is the council area's extent rounded out to 100 m; bbox_wgs84 is the envelope of its four corners. Work tiles are listed in config/full_tiles.json.
